purpose: Pin a public code-level implementation candidate for the GBM Targeted Search response and finite log-likelihood calculation, while preserving the separation between a GBM finite estimator, the Stachie joint association ranking, and the HOLD-LC-001 continuous physical timing owner.

authority_pointers.role: candidate-neutral continuous timing and four-stage map contract
physical response, calibration and timing owner fields

official_code_source.license: Apache-2.0 as displayed by the repository
official_code_source.source_role: Public generalized, mission-agnostic Fermi-GBM Targeted Search implementation built around Gamma-ray Data Tools; commit pin is immutable repository provenance, not an event-result hash.

exact_scope.finite_scope: Public code semantics for finite GBM counts/background/response likelihood and time-bin/sky handling only; no event run, no joint Lambda association reproduction, no continuous timing likelihood, no covariance and no prospective validation.
included: Code-level response construction and spacecraft-frame timing choices.
Code-level GBM counts/background/response likelihood and sky-prior combination.
Default finite search configuration and time-bin generation semantics.
The repository's GW170817 example and external data/template prerequisites.
excluded: The Stachie Q_L/Q_G population distributions and joint association Lambda background calibration.
Event-specific response/template bytes, gain calibration and versioned data products.
Detector-to-geocenter propagation, GW merger-time uncertainty, intrinsic lag and shared covariance.
F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs, candidate selection, score or prospective holdout.

outputs: marginalized finite log-likelihood ratio over spectral templates and sky locations
optimal SNR and two chi-square diagnostics
implementation_choices: power-law source-amplitude prior with default gamma=2.5
nonnegative background clipping and response-weighted variance terms
coinclr(logskyprior) combines a supplied sky prior with the log-likelihood
likelihood_py.owner_boundary: Finite detector counts/background/response estimator candidate; source code does not define a GW-to-GBM joint timing covariance or detector-to-geocenter correction.

configuration_py.owner_boundary: Repository defaults are implementation settings and require event-level version freeze before use.

search_py.time_bins: Durations use 1.024 * 2**k over the configured range; start steps are max(min_step, duration/num_steps), with alignment to binned data edges.
search_py.multi_instrument: Counts, background, variance and response arrays are stacked over instruments, with Earth/visibility sky masks and frame projection.
search_py.result_fields: Each finite time bin records start, duration, best sky location, fit status, optimal SNR, best template, photon flux, chi-square diagnostics and marginalized LLR.

response_py.time_rule: preprocess evaluates spacecraft frames and geocentric coordinates at each response-bin midpoint and caches response load points.
response_py.response_rule: The implementation assumes a constant response over a short-burst period, combines direct and atmospheric components, and linearly weights the nearest atmospheric azimuth templates.
response_py.visibility_rule: An Earth-occultation mask is generated from the loaded geocentric coordinates.
response_py.owner_boundary: This is an explicit response-construction candidate, not a source-approved validity/interpolation or detector-to-geocenter uncertainty contract.

priors_py.sky_prior: Uniform sky prior when no map is supplied; otherwise map a HEALPix probability density into the spacecraft frame and normalize it.
priors_py.owner_boundary: Sky-prior implementation only; no GW posterior version, spatial covariance or joint association calibration is admitted.

readme_and_example.repository_scope: The README calls GTS generalized and mission-agnostic, supplies installation requirements, and provides GBM and GW170817 examples.
readme_and_example.external_inputs: Examples require external Fermi GBM TTE/trigdat data, detector response templates and Gamma-ray Data Tools dependencies.
readme_and_example.reproducibility_boundary: The README does not pin the event file bytes, response-template archive, dependency lock or the complete Stachie joint-ranking implementation.

checks.detail: The public repository main ref resolves to commit 1bc1e913f97fd7195a7e297f8d6032a5c7758894 on 2026-08-30.
The inspected source files expose finite likelihood, time-bin, response-midpoint, atmospheric interpolation, Earth-mask and sky-prior paths.
A public code path and GW170817 example exist, but the exact event/template bytes, dependency lock, Stachie joint-ranking path and physical timing uncertainty packet are not frozen.
The public implementation is an additive T-061 candidate and does not replace T-054, T-059, their owner order or stopped-loop rules.

finding: The public GTS repository materially advances the owner intake by exposing code-level finite GBM likelihood and response paths: counts/background/response inputs, source-amplitude marginalization, midpoint spacecraft-frame evaluation, short-burst constant-response assumption, atmospheric template weighting, Earth masking and sky-prior normalization. Its GW170817 example also identifies the external TTE/trigdat/template inputs needed for a reproduction. The code is not yet an admitted HOLD-LC-001 owner because event/template bytes, dependency versions, response validity, detector-to-geocenter conversion, uncertainty/covariance, the Stachie joint Lambda background path and prospective lock remain missing.
decision_reason: This is a new public implementation source with inspectable finite estimator and response code, not another literature summary. It narrows the next reproduction packet while keeping all physical-owner and prospective admission boundaries explicit.
decision_scope: T0 public finite GBM code-owner candidate and reproduction checklist only; no event result, continuous timing, physical identity or empirical prediction.
assumptions: The repository main ref and commit hash recorded on 2026-08-30 are the intended public GTS edition for this intake.
The source code semantics extracted from the pinned file paths remain applicable until a new commit is pinned.
Repository defaults and short-burst assumptions are implementation choices, not automatically physical-owner decisions.
The local HOLD-LC-001 estimator and response-owner contracts remain controlling for continuous timing, calibration and covariance admission.
missing_assumptions: Immutable event data and response-template bytes with hashes, plus exact dependency/environment versions.
A source-owned mapping from the GTS finite LLR to the Stachie Q_G and joint Lambda path.
Event-specific response validity/interpolation, gain calibration and detector-to-geocenter conversion with uncertainty.
A common timing covariance, intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance law and sealed prospective holdout.
Independent primary/secondary/hostile reproduction of the code path on a frozen synthetic fixture before event use.

adversarial_review.check: Does a public repository automatically supply the physical owner for HOLD-LC-001?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: public availability does not freeze event bytes, calibration validity, uncertainty or source ownership.

adversarial_review.check: Can the GTS finite GBM LLR be treated as the complete Stachie joint Lambda?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the code exposes the GBM likelihood path but not the full Q_L/Q_G population calibration and joint background FAR implementation.

adversarial_review.check: Can midpoint spacecraft-frame response evaluation be treated as detector-to-geocenter correction?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: midpoint response generation and Earth masking do not define a detector-to-geocenter propagation correction or uncertainty budget.

adversarial_review.check: Can repository defaults be used as frozen event calibration or scorer values?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: defaults require event/template/dependency versioning and must be fixed before candidate residual inspection.

adversarial_review.check: Could this public code replace the established T-054 forward or T-059 inverse method?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: it is an additive T-061 finite owner candidate and leaves both methods unchanged.

next_action: Freeze the pinned GTS commit, dependency lock, response-template archive and exact GW170817 event inputs; run a synthetic primary/independent/hostile finite LLR and response-index reproduction before touching event data. Keep Stachie joint-ranking completion, detector-to-geocenter conversion, covariance, intrinsic-lag scoring and prospective credit locked, and continue unchanged T-054 owner intake in parallel.
stop_or_redesign: If the repository commit, templates or event inputs cannot be version-pinned, retain the code as public method provenance and do not admit HOLD-LC-001.
If the GTS finite LLR cannot be linked to the Stachie Q_G and joint Lambda path without post hoc choices, keep the two owner candidates separate.
If response midpoint/interpolation or Earth-mask choices change with candidate labels, invalidate the reproduction and issue a new versioned packet.
If continuous timing/covariance and a prospective lock remain absent, report finite GBM code evidence only.
non_claims: The public GTS code is not an admitted continuous Delta_t_det likelihood, detector-to-geocenter correction or covariance.
The finite GBM LLR and response path are not the complete Stachie joint association Lambda or its prospective scorer.
No event result, response value, candidate map, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs, prospective prediction or microscopic forward map is admitted.
No QFT/Yang--Mills/gravity identity, Pre-A, C6, A13, Sector-A, continuum, physical-vacuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim follows.
The established T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods, owner order and stopped-loop rules are unchanged.
